item.title: ABC News: Regional women share postpartum journeys to create change
item.description: Taegan Partington was stunned by the care gaps she found moving to regional SA after giving birth. She and other women want to have their say.

item.title: ABC News: Asian grocer firebombed in Melbourne's west
item.description: An Asian grocer on Ballarat Road in Deer Park has been damaged in a firebombing overnight, with the offenders still on the run.

item.title: ABC News: Recalling the news no-one saw as South Australia plunged into darkness
item.description: South Australians were expecting a severe storm on September 28, 2016, and news crews were on the road gathering information. But when the entire state lost power, the sad truth is not many people would have seen the reports.

item.title: ABC News: Young officer killed in Sydney car crash honoured at wall of remembrance
item.description: The NSW premier says this year's National Police Remembrance Day is particularly poignant after the "tragic loss" of Constable Mia Lay.

item.title: ABC News: Foster care reunification model broken, experts say
item.description: Foster care experts say there needs to be more support for families reuniting with children following the death of an 8-month-old less than three days after she was returned to her biological parents.

item.title: ABC News: The political divide moving into the family home
item.description: As One Nation's popularity remains strong in the polls, gen Z is the least likely demographic to vote for the party, with support coming from older generations. But how is this political divide playing out in family relationships?

item.title: ABC News: Lab-grown blood offering hope for family with ultra-rare grouping
item.description: Joe Fa'agase is one of only 14 people in Australia with the blood type Jk null. Now, new Australian research aims to create lab-grown blood at scale for use in such patients.

item.title: ABC News: Melbourne council endorses antisemitism action plan in Victorian first
item.description: Glen Eira City Council will become the first council in the state to endorse an antisemitism strategy, following a reported rise from residents in antisemitic incidents.

item.title: ABC News: The surprising origin of Tasmania's cherry blossom festival
item.description: Thirty years ago, a Japanese love of Tasmanian new-season soba noodles led to a cross-cultural gift of hundreds of cherry blossom trees, now celebrated at the annual Hanami Trail festival.

item.title: ABC News: Mayor defends cocktails, AirPods, steaks, KFC credit card spend
item.description: A Tasmanian mayor defends items bought with a work-issued credit card that racked up more than $17,000 across three years.

item.title: ABC News: For Xi, America is no longer the centre of China's strategy
item.description: At the glittering high point of the White House state dinner, the hierarchy of the world's two great powers was laid bare.

item.title: ABC News: What North Korea is really building with new bridges to Russia and China
item.description: Trade pathways or potential military corridors? Inside North Korea's latest push for bridges linking it to its closest allies.
